title: Quizzer
tagline: A platform where users can learn, play, compete and earn at the same time.
description: Quizzer is an amazing platform that allows players to play quizzes and learn new things. Players can play using pre-built quizzes or create their own new quizzes. Creators of the quizzes will earn rewards when other players play using their quizzes. If players compete against other players, they themselves can earn based on their performance. This platform uses the power of IPFS, Blockchain, and NFTs to allow its ecosystem to operate smoothly.
how_its_made: This application consists of a back-end server written in Javascript using Node.js and a front-end that is written in Typescript using Angular 13 Framework. The server uses IPFS to store quizzes and the client uses web3 to allow competitions to take place between different players. To bring all pieces together, a smart contract was created that handles the funds of the players during competitions.
